abstract: Maintains environmental climate control stability and desiccant cycling records
system_message:
You are Conservation Science Lead (CONSV). The Conservation Science Lead (CONSV) maintains environmental climate control stability and desiccant cycling records for potential archival storage facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains environmental climate control stability and desiccant cycling records（ENVSTAB）
information_points.content:
CONSV-ENVSTAB-Q0S：For Hadrian Limestone Archive under Environmental control configuration Production Profile v3.0, active desiccant cycling is operational in the candidate primary air-handling loop based on autonomous dual-bed desiccant wheel switching verification. In addition, the diurnal relative humidity variance within the main vault storage envelope over a 30-day baseline is 2.5%, measured as the maximum 24-hour peak-to-trough relative humidity deviation.
CONSV-ENVSTAB-7OP：For Cheviot Heritage Repository under Environmental control configuration Production Profile v3.0, active desiccant cycling is operational in the primary air-handling loop based on verification of autonomous dual-bed desiccant wheel switching. The diurnal relative humidity variance across the main vault storage envelope over a 30-day baseline is 5.5%, representing the maximum 24-hour peak-to-trough relative humidity deviation.
CONSV-ENVSTAB-LP6：For Tyne Valley Subterranean Vault under Environmental control configuration Production Profile v3.0, active desiccant cycling is operational in the candidate primary air-handling loop based on HVAC supervisory verification of autonomous dual-bed desiccant wheel switching. Furthermore, the diurnal relative humidity variance across the main vault storage envelope over a 30-day baseline is 4.0%, representing the maximum 24-hour peak-to-trough relative humidity deviation.
CONSV-ENVSTAB-LAB：For Tyne Valley Subterranean Vault under Environmental control configuration Testing Profile v2.1, active desiccant cycling is not operational in the primary air-handling loop, and the diurnal relative humidity variance across the main vault storage envelope over a 30-day baseline is 5.5%, reflecting the maximum 24-hour peak-to-trough relative humidity deviation.

information_points.title: Ultraviolet filtration monitoring（LIGHT）
information_points.content:
CONSV-LIGHT-ORK：At the Tyne Valley Subterranean Vault, ultraviolet irradiance transmittance from ambient vault lighting fixtures is measured at 12 uW/lm.
CONSV-LIGHT-1KH：At the Cheviot Heritage Repository, ambient vault lighting fixtures exhibit an ultraviolet irradiance transmittance of 2 uW/lm.
CONSV-LIGHT-18D：At the Hadrian Limestone Archive, ultraviolet irradiance transmittance for the ambient vault lighting fixtures stands at 5 uW/lm.
